domain_description: Hydraulic fracturing design, execution, and analysis including frac design modeling, proppant selection and transport, fluid chemistry, pressure diagnostics, microseismic monitoring, refrac candidate selection, coiled tubing operations, stage optimization, flowback analysis, and well interference evaluation. Based on SPE technical papers, API recommended practices, and industry-standard fracture mechanics models.
authority_sources: API RP 100 (Hydraulic Fracturing — Well Integrity and Fracture Containment)
API RP 19C (Recommended Practice for Measurement of Proppants)
PKN and KGD Fracture Geometry Models
SPE Monograph Vol. 12 (Recent Advances in Hydraulic Fracturing)
ISO 13503 (Petroleum and Natural Gas Industries — Completion Fluids)

engines.name: Frac Design Engine
engines.function: Design hydraulic fracture treatments including fracture geometry modeling, pump schedule optimization, fluid volume calculations, and treatment pressure prediction using PKN, KGD, and pseudo-3D models with real formation data.
doctrine_topics: PKN and KGD fracture geometry models
closure stress profiling and min horizontal stress
pad volume and fluid efficiency calculations
formation mechanical properties for frac design

golden_queries.question: Design a hydraulic fracture treatment for a Wolfcamp A bench horizontal well with 10,000 ft lateral, 40 stages, given closure stress of 8,500 psi, Young's modulus 4.5 MMpsi, and permeability of 200 nanodarcy
Interpret a Nolte-Smith log-log pressure plot showing Mode I behavior transitioning to Mode III during a Bone Spring treatment

engines.name: Proppant Selection Engine
engines.function: Analyze proppant types, conductivity performance, crush resistance, transport mechanics, embedment effects, and selection optimization for specific reservoir and closure stress conditions per API RP 19C and 19D.
doctrine_topics: crush resistance testing per API RP 19C

golden_queries.question: Select the optimal proppant for a Delaware Basin Wolfcamp well with closure stress of 9,200 psi, bottomhole temperature of 220F, and soft clay-rich formation. Compare white sand, RCS, and ceramic options.

engines.name: Fluid Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze fracturing fluid systems including slickwater, crosslinked gels, hybrid systems, viscoelastic surfactants, and acid fracturing chemistry including breaker design, friction reduction, and formation compatibility.
doctrine_topics: slickwater fluid design and friction reduction
crosslinked gel systems borate and zirconate
hybrid fluid system design and scheduling
acid fracturing fluid systems and etching
environmental compliance and green chemistry alternatives

golden_queries.question: Design a hybrid fluid system for a high-temperature (280F) carbonate reservoir with 12% clay content, specifying base fluid, crosslinker, breaker schedule, and clay stabilizer

engines.name: Pressure Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze fracture treatment pressure data including ISIP, closure pressure, net pressure, DFIT interpretation, step rate tests, and real-time pressure matching for fracture geometry estimation.
doctrine_topics: DFIT analysis and closure pressure determination
step rate test analysis for fracture extension pressure

golden_queries.question: Interpret a DFIT dataset showing ISIP of 7,800 psi, with G-function plot exhibiting a hump signature and square-root time plot showing concave-up behavior before closure
required_elements: G-function hump interpretation as pressure-dependent leakoff

engines.name: Microseismic Engine
engines.function: Analyze microseismic monitoring data for fracture mapping, stimulated reservoir volume estimation, event classification, magnitude analysis, and treatment optimization feedback.

golden_queries.question: A 40-stage Wolfcamp horizontal well microseismic survey shows events extending 800 ft in height, 1,200 ft in half-length, with a dominant cloud trending N30E. Interpret the fracture geometry and recommend treatment modifications for remaining stages.

engines.name: Refrac Design Engine
engines.function: Analyze refracturing candidate selection, diversion technology, restimulation design, depletion modeling, stress reorientation assessment, and economic justification for refracturing campaigns.
doctrine_topics: production decline analysis for refrac timing
historical treatment analysis for refrac design
refrac case histories and lessons learned

golden_queries.question: Evaluate a 2015-vintage Bone Spring horizontal well producing 30 BOPD (down from 800 BOPD IP) with original 20-stage plug-and-perf completion using 800 lb/ft sand loading as a refrac candidate

engines.name: Coiled Tubing Engine
engines.function: Analyze coiled tubing operations for fracturing applications including CT-conveyed plug-and-perf, CT-activated tools, fatigue life management, buckling analysis, and operational limits.
doctrine_topics: CT buckling analysis helical and sinusoidal
CT milling operations for composite plugs
CT size selection for horizontal applications
CT real-time monitoring and data acquisition
CT string design and taper management

golden_queries.question: Determine the maximum reach of 2-inch CT in a horizontal well with 10,000 ft measured depth, 8,000 ft lateral, 7-inch casing, with wellbore fluid of 8.6 ppg brine for plug milling operations

engines.name: Stage Optimization Engine
engines.function: Optimize hydraulic fracturing stage design including cluster spacing, perforation strategy, limited entry design, stage length optimization, and completion efficiency analysis for horizontal wells.
doctrine_topics: stage length optimization via stress analysis
fiber optic DAS/DTS for cluster efficiency
production log analysis for stage contribution

golden_queries.question: DAS/DTS data from offset wells shows only 40% of perforation clusters are taking fluid in a 200-ft stage length with 5 clusters per stage. Redesign the completion to improve cluster efficiency.
required_elements: perforation diameter and count per cluster

engines.name: Flowback Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze post-fracture flowback data including fluid recovery, proppant flowback, pressure trends, rate-transient analysis, and early-time production diagnostics for fracture effectiveness evaluation.
doctrine_topics: flowback rate management and choke strategy

golden_queries.question: A Wolfcamp well is flowing back at 2,000 BWPD with 200 MCFGPD after 72 hours, with declining water rate and increasing gas-water ratio. Flowback fluid salinity is 180,000 ppm TDS. Interpret the flowback behavior and recommend choke management.
required_elements: formation water vs frac water identification

engines.name: Well Interference Engine
engines.function: Analyze frac-driven interactions between wells including pressure communication, frac hits, production interference, protective measures, and spacing optimization using field data and geomechanical modeling.
doctrine_topics: well spacing optimization from interference data
stress shadow effects on infill wells
depletion effects on infill fracture geometry
production impact quantification from frac hits

golden_queries.question: A parent well 660 ft away experienced a 2,000 psi pressure spike and began producing frac fluid during completion of a child well. Analyze the interference event and recommend mitigation for remaining stages.
